== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on every Virtual Legacy [[Red Leader (V)]] article. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. One column per published text state; {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged from the previous column. Same-words image changes are not columns: [[Red Leader (V) (Errata 3)]] shares the [[Red Leader (V) (Errata 2)]] column. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
